Preview harness — build 7 — web mobile, both paths, composed from sliced exports in real layout containers, so the pinned regions, the scrolling, the drawers and the map's loading beat are genuine. Two routes, each closing on itself: rail → drawer → checkout → rail and rail → tickets → row → map → hotel → room → review → checkout → rail. Images are embedded; this file works offline.

Flow 01 + 02 — Ticketmaster Travel, web mobile

Package, or build your own

One rail, two ways out. Take the promoted package and review it in a drawer that comes up from the bottom edge — or tap Build Your Own from $400 at the foot of the rail and pick the seats, the hotel and the room yourself. Both end on the same secure-the-package beat and both hand you back to the event, so the rail is where either path is picked up again.
